content.short: NFTgators is a daily dose of NFT news and insights from including web3, metaverse stories, and gaming.
content.description: NFTgators curates a daily briefing of NFT news and insights from across the industry, keeping you informed about the latest developments and trends. Coverage spans Web3, metaverse stories, blockchain games, market moves, partnerships, launches, and other related topics. Each day, you'll receive a focused, easy-to-digest roundup that connects the dots between these evolving areas and helps you stay up to date with what's shaping the NFT space.
